name: the-quick-menu-opens-under-the-sidebar-button
description: The puzzle button at the right end of the sidebar's address field opens the quick menu in its own child window, placed under that button. The card is a separate document, so the only way to see it land in the right place is to read both: the button's box in the sidebar, and the card's own window position from the browser's log line.

actions.note: the reserved chrome context lands about 670ms after startup and the menu's WebContents needs it
ssh-launched Atrium is not frontmost on a clean snapshot

actions.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.urlrow .qm-open'); if (!b) { return 'no button'; } const r = b.getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.round(r.left) + ',' + Math.round(r.top) + ' ' + Math.round(r.width) + 'x' + Math.round(r.height); })()
actions.note: written into the log so a card that lands wrong can be re-checked against the button's own numbers

actions.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.urlrow .qm-open'); if (!b) { return 'no button'; } b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', {bubbles: true, cancelable: true, view: window})); return 'clicked'; })()
(() => { const c = document.querySelector('.qm-card'); if (!c) { return 'no card'; } return document.querySelector('.qm-manage') ? 'card' : 'incomplete'; })()
actions.note: THE GATE. 'no card' means the widget showed an empty document, which is a route or a grd problem, not a placement one.
the spec's 232px, measured rather than assumed

assertions.desc: the button was there to click
the menu document rendered its card
the card is the spec's 232px wide

assertions.label: the-window-placed-the-menu
assertions.desc: the button's rect crossed from the page to the window and became a box. The numbers on this line are what a geometry regression shows up in.

assertions.label: escape-closed-the-menu
assertions.desc: Escape reached the widget's own key handler. Close() logs this only when the widget was visible, so the line is proof it went down rather than proof the key was pressed.
